name: Chasing A-Me 01
label: Quest
description: Chasing A-Me 01: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A little further investigation shows a panel that slides open. Clearly written above some wiring is the statement, "Replace Mithril Casing And Turn Power Off Then On."
Taking a moment to replace the panel, you wonder if it'll be that simple to fix A-Me 01 and get her back to Karna Remtravel near Marshall's Refuge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The panel in which the mithril casing goes is still closed shut. The rest of A-Me 01 remains inert.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You remove the panel from A-Me 01's back yet again and carefully remove the old mithril casing that seems to have burnt out. The new one slides into place easily. The only thing left to do, assuming the mithril casing was the problem, is to flip the switch to the "Off" position, and then back to the "On" position.
